question: Who was the Chairman of Union Carbide India Limited during The Bhopal Gas Tragedy in Bhopal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Warren Anderson**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Warren Anderson** was the **Chairman **of **Union Carbide India Limited (UCIL)** during the **Bhopal Gas Tragedy** in Bhopal.
 
• The Bhopal Gas Tragedy occurred on the night of **2-3 December 1984** at the Union C
